Ravenlake

Infrastructure for on-call teams that are tired of being paged.

What it does

Ravenlake sits between your monitoring stack and your pager. It groups related alerts into a single incident, ranks incidents by blast radius, and suppresses the ones that resolved themselves before anyone read them.

Teams running Ravenlake page a median of 4.1 fewer people per week.
